Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Roorkee recruitment is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the JRF post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 14 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech/M. Tech./MS/Integrated M.Tech./Integrated M.Sc. in specific fields and a GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000/- to Rs. 40,700/- per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the IIT Roorkee office.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
